description: S8: Manual section review harness profile. Defines section coverage, safe_to_send rules, reviewer decision values, and issue classification. Operational/dev review only ΓÇö not HITL governance.

UNREVIEWED.note: Default ΓÇö reviewer has not acted

APPROVE.note: Reviewer explicitly approved. safe_to_send=true only when set explicitly.

EDIT.note: Reviewer wants to edit before sending

REJECT.note: Section is rejected ΓÇö resume must not send

safe_to_send_policy.note: safe_to_send=true requires explicit APPROVE decision AND no blocking support/exit status

overall_status_values.ALL_APPROVED: All sections reviewed and approved by reviewer
overall_status_values.PARTIAL_REVIEW: Some sections reviewed but not all
overall_status_values.BLOCKED: One or more sections have blocking issues
overall_status_values.NEEDS_EDIT: One or more sections need editing

issue_types.MISSING_EXIT_CHECK: deterministic exit check not provided or UNKNOWN
issue_types.FAILING_EXIT_CHECK: exit check verdict is FAIL or BLOCKED
issue_types.VERBATIM_MISMATCH_WARNING: verbatim section may have been modified (hash absent ΓÇö WARN only)
issue_types.BULLET_ORDINAL_GAP: bullet ordinal sequence has a gap
